selection_rule: Select using the training split only; do not inspect persistence outcomes on calibration or test before freezing the spec and evaluation rule.
primary_event: P1/P2 hold over the rollout, candidate Z_free is reached, and every subsequently observed product state through the finite horizon remains in candidate Z_free
collapse_policy: Reject the V_phi candidate and establish no Z_free if the post-fit collapse audit fails.
interpretation_limit: sampled model-scope evidence over the observed horizon; not support-wide or infinite-time deductive closure
